# Bundled wallpapers

`default.jpg` — default vault home background (v0.4.0, #32).

**Provenance:** AI-generated by the app owner (Demirhan / OfferForge) with **Grok
(xAI)** and supplied to the project on 2026-09-26 for use as the default background.
It is not a stock or third-party photo. Under xAI's consumer terms the user owns
the output and commercial use is allowed; attribution is requested, so the app
shows **"Varsayılan arka plan: Created with Grok" / "Default background: Created
with Grok"** at the bottom of Settings (under the version line). The image was not
cropped or edited (any watermark kept): only re-encoded (JPEG q90, progressive,
metadata stripped), same size 1008×1792, ~310 KB.

Used by `VaultHomeScreen` when no vault photo is chosen and Settings → Wallpaper
has the picture swatch selected (default). Custom vault photos override it;
"Arka planı kaldır" returns to it; colour swatches ("Düz renk") switch to a
plain gradient. A top/bottom dark scrim (`GizliTheme.homeImageScrim`) keeps
text readable on this light image.
